basic_info.description: Poised on a classic San Francisco street, 65 Danton Street is a timeless blend of vintage elegance & thoughtful updates. This beautifully preserved 2+ BD, 1+ BA home offers 1,012 sq ft of curated living space on a 2,500 sq ft lot where charm meets modern comfort.  The luminous living room features a barrel-front bay window, a fireplace, & period details like crown picture molding, built-in shelving, & an original telephone nook. Contemporary flooring throughout the living areas & bedrooms adds a fresh touch to the home's storied appeal.  A formal dining room flows into the updated kitchen, where rich cabinetry, granite counters, a cool glass tile backsplash, & grey tile floors elevate everyday cooking. The bathroom echoes this aesthetic, creating a refined and cohesive feel.  Two rear bedrooms overlook a serene backyard with mature apple, fig, & lemon trees, plus a large circular patio ideal for al fresco dining or quiet mornings.  The expansive garage level includes laundry, a second full bath, & a versatile bonus room perfect for a guest suite, studio, or office.  Located in Mission Terrace near Glen Park BART, Muni, I-280, & Alemany. Moments to cafes, Canyon Market, Safeway & great eateries like Gialina & Manzoni. 65 Danton is a home with heart and room to grow.
